Very amazing food and so friendly staff!!!
Jul 2016
We came here for a lunch and did enjoy our time so much.They serve very delicious food.Chicken is so good and meat loaf is the best one I ate.Really so tasty food.It is so clean also.I would recommend to come there and try the eastern food as for me I have been to Egypt for 6 times for tourism and I will say that here in Vietnam in Ho Chi Minh far away from the real Arab country,they do their best job to make guests feel comfortable and enjoy their time.They treated us with the free tea twice and free watermelon.I have never seen such restaurant which is welcoming you with a free food.Traveling to Egypt for 6 times and I didn't try such good food as I tried here.I am so happy I did visit the restaurant.And I want to say that the girl who is working there is so nice and helpful as we are travelers and we went to Cambodia she helped us a lot telling what to visit in Cambodia.I wish to come back here again! I wish for this restaurant growing and blessing.Thank you for such nice food and treat.Keep on going!

Delightful Taste
May 2016 • Friends
We arrived for early lunch. It was pretty quiet as it was not the peak lunch hour yet. There was a lot to choose from. They were all very appealing. We had the grilled chicken set. The serving was generous. The chicken was served with rice and fries. The mango juice was so good and thick. The chicken set came with tea and cut watermelon as dessert afterwards. Simple yet delightful taste. The waitresses were very courteous although not very fluent in English.
